versions.changelog:
Initial release of 辉火 Token 优化器 (huo15-token-optimizer):

- Provides systematic scanning, cleaning, and monitoring of OpenClaw workspace token usage.
- Default dry-run mode ensures no modifications without user confirmation; all actions are backup-first and non-destructive.
- Never automatically replaces AGENTS.md; preserves custom rules.
- Supports manual restoration from backups and threshold configuration.
- Includes alerting when DREAMS or AGENTS files exceed safe sizes.
- Triggered via common token-related phrases for easy activation.
